responsibility: This file contains target helper routines used by NDS32 machine-description patterns for RTL expansion, instruction splitting, and final asm template construction. Its responsibilities include emitting conditional branch sequences and long-branch fallbacks, expanding TLS and symbolic address materialization, synthesizing constants and masks, validating/handling load-multiple and store-multiple bases, splitting doubleword operations into SImode pieces, and producing asm text for TLS and symbol-relocation sequences. It is the procedural support layer used by nds32.md and related .md files when declarative patterns need target-specific C logic.
